lines.en: : One second! Babe, are you expecting a package or something?
: This is one of the very few occasions in which I am not.
: Then who the hell is knocking on the door? Should I go answer it?
: We’re millennials. We don’t answer the door. You’re being reckless again.
: O...On the way now!
: You’re going to be murdered and I am not prepared to deal with that.
: Oh, Nao-chan. It’s just you. And you...apparently need help?
: With...what exactly?
: Please wait here while I call the cops.
: Kaori needs alone time? With another human being? Really?
: Then, uhh...sure? We’re kind of watching TV right now. Will it...be long? Boys are quick, right? And...it is a boy, right?
: Yeah, I probably shouldn’t be asking you anyway.
: Do you want, like...tea or something? What do you drink?
: Nothing? Got it.
: Just write it down! You have a notebook!
: Wakana, I’m back. And I have a child now.
: Okay. I have tried to be supportive, Osako. But this journey of self-discovery has gone too far. Take it back immediately.
: I don’t think I can.
: Damn it. You went to a kill-shelter, didn’t you?
: Do you really not recognize Nao-chan? Kaori’s...daughter thing? She’s lived next to us for, like...years now.
: What reason would I have to ever look at a child? What is it doing here? And why does the neighbor possess one when she is younger than us?
: I don’t-
: Also, my parents can never find out about this or they’ll go back to pestering me for a grandchild.
: Hah...Nao’s just going to hang out here for a little bit while Kaori has some “alone time” with her boyfriend.
: I’m sorry, I think I may have misheard. I could have sworn you mentioned just now that Kaori has a boyfriend.
: You’re absolutely positive it was a boy, Nao-chan?
: Yeah, she seems pretty confident. And seeing as her opening note was “sex,” I think it’s safe to assume that there’s some stuff going on over there right now.
: How noticeable do you think it would be if we were to drill a small hole in the wall?
: I think that would be a major invasion of their privacy. But also I think that they probably wouldn’t notice and I am just as curious as you.
: Do we own a drill?
: Yes, but I think using it in the way you’re suggesting might void our lease.
: Oh, you don’t have to worry. I wouldn’t actually let that happen. Wakana and I are just sort of...mutually fascinated by Kaori’s existence.
: She hasn’t ever really brought anyone home before. At least...not to our knowledge. But if she’s found somebody, I’m sure we can both say we’re happy for her.
: Not if our fantasy threesome is suddenly off the table. I will never forgive whatever man she dragged in there if that is the case.
: Wow. You really are just horrible around kids, aren’t you?
: They confuse me and make me uncomfortable and I wish they’d all just go away.
: You’re a teacher, babe.
: And chronically depressed. Do you believe that to be a coincidence, Osako?
: What’s this guy even like, Nao-chan? How long have they known each other? Where’d they meet? Is it serious?
: Why, this is more gossiping than you did all throughout college. Are you actually good with children?
: In limited doses, I guess. You already know I don’t actually want one, though.
: Well, that is great news as we lack the proper hardware to create one and you would have to be the one to carry it as I would break.
: Aww...that’s really cute. Babe, she says this guy and Kaori found her together. Which makes him kind of like-
: Wait. What do you mean “found” you?
: Kind of like what? If you’re going to read her notes, at least read them in their entirety. I can’t see from over here. My eyes hurt.
: She says he’s like her dad. But again, that they “found” her. So this isn’t really an adoption type situation and-
: What’s she saying now? My eyes have not magically recovered and I still cannot see.
: Nothing. She’s just scribbling now.
: Why do I feel like things are about to get even worse?
: You’re the one who invited her in. Now we have to babysit and we can’t finish the Food that Built America. I hope you’re happy with yourself, Osako. You have finally crossed the line.
: This is not really how I expected this conversation to go when you asked to come inside.
: Also, I don’t recall ever telling you I’m a lesbian. So I’m not really sure how you-
: Oh, thank god! It’s the door again!
: You. Child. Why don’t you speak? It disturbs me.
: She’s mute, Wakana! She literally can’t!
: I see. Then you are automatically my favorite child by default. And I will allow you to stay so long as you will not interrupt my Netflix binge. Do you understand?
: Do you know how to make tea? What are you capable of exactly?
: I have no idea what you’re trying to say, but I will take chamomile. Thank you.
: Akira? What are you doing here so late? We’re kind of in the middle of something right now.
: Sorry for interrupting. I was just wondering if a small girl with a notebook dropped by because, if so, I am here to reclaim her.
: Wait, you’re the guy?! The one Kaori’s seeing?! The one Nao-chan thinks is her dad?!
: She thinks I’m what? This is news to me.
: Great! Then I’ll keep everything else she said a secret as well! What the fuck are you doing sleeping with Kaori, though?!
: Why do you seem so shocked by this? I’m sleeping with everyone.
: Yeah, but Kaori is an adult!
: So is Imani and I have slept with her in the same room as you. Besides, I’ve known Kaori longer than any of you guys. The shocking part is how long it took for this to happen.
: Is it weird? Like...doing it with her? It’s gotta be weird, right?
: Very weird. But also really hot. She’s a very unique lay that I plan on experiencing many more times.
: Fuck. Now I’ll be getting your sloppy seconds if the fantasy threesome ever happens.
: I don’t know what that is, but I’d like to hear everything you are willing to tell me about it right now.
: No! Now, you’re going to get that girl out of my house! Because this is the first time I’ve ever had an extended “conversation” with her and she’s totally creeping me the hell out!
: Oh no. Did you meet Amber as well? Tell me you didn’t agree to the hair cocoon. I won’t be able to text you anymore.
: Akira, what the hell are you even talking about?!
: I really wish I knew. She’s still in there then?
: Yes. But I need you to promise me that you aren’t going to molest her even if she really really wants you to.
: What? Do you seriously think I’d-
: Yes.
: Even if she’s-
: Yes.
: Fine, I promise.
: Good boy. I’ll go get her now.
: Call me that again and I’ll have to have sex with you. It won’t just be a forbidden fantasy anymore.
: You lay a finger on me and I will break every bone in your body. Nao-chan! Time to go! Your “dad” is here to- why are you going through our cabinets?
: She’s making me tea. And if you force her to leave right now, you will need to take over. I can not get off this couch for the next twelve hours or I will die.
: Hah. Fine. Go. Shoo. I will make tea. And be less weird when you get home!
I take Nao back to the apartment and sit down in front of her while Kaori takes a shower to clean off the residue of her lessons.
But what I’m currently unsure of is whether or not I should talk to her about what transpired in here or just...ignore it.
Because ignoring it would be the right thing to do when you...factor out how the actual right thing to do would be to just...never do anything in the first place.
But that ship has sailed and this girl has now watched me engage in a sex act with her mother. So if I am her father, it is only right that I set the record straight sooner rather than later.
: Did you really call me your dad?
But of course I ask her that instead because my other daughter is currently MIA and I am desperately seeking validation. God, I hate myself.
: And, while you’re writing — if the answer is yes, then why? I barely ever see you. And I certainly don’t treat you like my daughter. I’m not even convinced you’re actually human yet.
: Did it really, though? Because all I did was follow Kaori around while she stared at some weird map thing with your logo on it.
: If there’s a reason specifically that I happened to be there when that happened, what is it? Because I sure as hell don’t know.
: With all due respect, that’s just wishful thinking on your end. You can’t really learn things here because every time you do, it comes on the back of a thousand more questions.
: Like, say we get teleported into some other pocket dimension and some other god decides to throw a bunch of bullshit at us, what’ll we walk away with?
: Because that literally just happened and neither one of us has any clue what’s going on. Right?
: Well, you and I have different definitions of fun then because things like that are always happening to me. And chances are you just got sucked in on my coattails.
: Help with what? Because just figuring out what you are doesn’t really do anything for me in the end. I have much bigger problems I need to get to the bottom of. And you-
: Hah...
: And you might be special. But unless you hold the keys to the universe-
: What do you...mean by “the world is broken?”
: Remember...what?
: No, Nao...
: There is no “real” god...just a bunch of silly ideas that different people want us to believe in.
: If you want to know why we’re here, I can’t tell you. And I can’t tell you how to get out either since we’ll all end up right back here in the end.
: So you’re right when you say the world is broken. I’m just not sure if you understand exactly what that means.
: But then again, neither do I. And I likely never will without the help of some miracle.
It seems like she hesitates what she scribbles down this time — like she’s unsure if me giving up means I’ve stopped thinking entirely.
I haven’t though. Because when she turns the notebook back around, she’s written exactly what I’ve been expecting.
: Yeah...maybe you will.
The two of us sit in silence for a few minutes before Nao switches the TV to some show about American food and just...ignores the weight of the world and how it crushes me.
I feel a bit like Giles Corey.
I’m reminded of the worm.
Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!
Kaori’s lust has increased to [kaori_lust]!
Nao-chan’s affection has increased to [nao_love]!
